_note: PROSPECTIVE (Expansion 18, PROS-18, wip/expansion18-preparation; not live gameplay). A settlement's capability per industry, SET-B (spec s.4), in the schema MIN_A_ARCHITECTURE.md s.9 sketched for SET-A: industries -> levels -> needs. A level holds when every need of it and of every level below it holds; levels are derived from the world (people, skills, tools, stock, structures, transport, records), never stored as truth. Mining is external: its level comes from MIN-D (Build 17) through MiningCapabilityAdapter and is never computed here. Need vocabulary is MIN-D's (game/data/capabilities.json on wip/b17-mind b0506db: practitioners {jobs, skill, min_level, count, as}, station {type}, structure {what}, transport {any: handcart | carry}, deposit_access, records, portal) plus stock, industry and any, so at the Build 18 reconciliation these industries move into capabilities.json unchanged (docs/expansion18/DESIGN.md section 8). Every threshold below is an agent proposal, provisional (owner question Q18-2: thresholds and the first industries). SYNC-17 (Build 17 cd7439c, MIN-SKILLCAP): practitioners are counted by Skills level and the tool of the needed kind (an optional `tool` key, as in capabilities.json), never by job title, except where the game's own rule makes a trade the sole performer (farming: only farmers work the manor's fields, NPCBrain field workers; the analogue of MIN-D's assayer). The resident player counts by the villagers' rule; a shared household tool counts once (Discovery.practitioner).

mining.name: Mining
mining._note: Owned by MIN-D (Build 17, wip/b17-mind, not final). Levels 1-4: surface extraction, prospecting and assay, open pit, underground (spec s.4). Consumed only through MiningCapabilityAdapter.

effects._note: Owner Q18-9 and Q18-11 (2026-10-21) and Q18-11A closed (2026-10-22, docs/directives/2026-10-22_q18_11a_conditional_decision.md and 2026-10-22_q18_11a_final_decision.md; X18-CAPNUM): capability levels 0-10 affect pay and production output only, never permission. AdjustedPay = BasePay x PayMultiplier(industry, level); AdjustedOutput = BaseOutput x OutputMultiplier(industry, level), the bases from the existing systems. OutputMultiplier is applied as less time per unit (faster work), never as more units from the same inputs: every unit still consumes its full recipe inputs or depletes its deposit (DESIGN.md section 9). Multiplier at level L = 1 + output_max[industry] x shape[L] for output, 1 + output_max[industry] x pay_ratio x shape[L] for pay. ACTIVE PROFILE = approved (the owner's numbers). The level is the EFFECTIVE level (Q18-11B, 2026-10-22); until the owner approves its composition (X18-CAPCOMP) there is no live 0-10 level in the game, so the live hook (CapabilityHook) stays off and only analysis runs force a level. Every other profile is an UNAPPROVED candidate or a SUPERSEDED hypothesis, kept for analysis and the record (docs/expansion18/CAPABILITY_CURVES.md, CAPABILITY_SIMULATIONS.md).

shapes._note: Share of the full bonus reached at each level 0..10 (0 = baseline). owner_candidate: the owner's example table (master directive section 5, production bonus / 20 percent). front_loaded: (1 - e^(-kL)) / (1 - e^(-10k)) with k = 0.3812, 80 percent of the gain by level 4 (the research's ~80 percent of the gain by ~40 percent of the span, RESEARCH_DIGEST.md (b)). intermediate: their mean.

neutral.label: No effect (every multiplier 1.0): the baseline for comparisons; the game's active profile until 2026-10-22

owner_candidate.label: UNAPPROVED candidate: the owner's example, +20% output and +8% pay at level 10, every industry

front_loaded.label: UNAPPROVED candidate: same totals, 80% of the gain by level 4

intermediate.label: UNAPPROVED candidate: same totals, between the two shapes

differentiated.label: UNAPPROVED candidate: industry-differentiated totals and shapes (simple work lower and faster, crafts higher and slower)

conservative.label: UNAPPROVED test hypothesis (owner directive 2026-10-21, X18-SIM): about +10% output and +5% pay at level 10, every industry, the owner's diminishing-returns shape

moderate.label: UNAPPROVED test hypothesis (X18-SIM): about +20% output and +8% pay at level 10 (the owner's example)

aggressive.label: UNAPPROVED test hypothesis (X18-SIM): about +35% output and +15% pay at level 10

revised_bounded.label: SUPERSEDED by `approved` (2026-10-22): the agent's revised hypothesis (X18-SIM). The owner approved its six non-farming industries as Option A and replaced its farming 0.0 by F1. Kept for the record of the X18-SIM runs. UNAPPROVED revised test hypothesis (X18-SIM, agent proposal): small output gains where the work draws on a finite natural source (mining +5%, forestry +5%), none on farming output (the crop is the land's; faster work only frees time), moderate gains in the crafts limited by their inputs (smithing +15%, carpentry +15%, tanning +10%); pay at 0.4 of output (research 0.33-0.45); front-loaded for the simple trades, the owner's shape for the crafts

approved.label: APPROVED (owner, 2026-10-22; Q18-11A closed; X18-CAPNUM): Option A for mining and forestry (+5% output, +2% pay at level 10, front-loaded), trade and tanning (+10%, +4%, intermediate), carpentry and smithing (+15%, +6%, the owner's shape); farming F1: +10% work rate and +4% pay on paid farm labour at level 10, intermediate (work rate 0/2.5/4.4/5.9/7.0/7.8/8.5/9.1/9.5/9.8/10.0%, pay 0/1.0/1.8/2.4/2.8/3.1/3.4/3.6/3.8/3.9/4.0%), labour time only, never yield (yield_fixed)

effects.unmapped_external: An external industry (mining: MIN-D stages 1-4) has no agreed mapping to the 0-10 scale (a reconciliation item, DESIGN.md section 8): its multipliers stay 1.0 until the mapping is decided.
effects._yield_fixed_note: Owner Q18-11A F1 (2026-10-22): in these industries the multiplier is a WORK RATE only (labour time of tilling, sowing, cutting, pen feeding, milking, shearing); it never raises a production rate or yield: the crop is the land's, the animals' produce is theirs (SettlementLedger.tick applies 1.0 to their production).

transport._note: Route planning (TradeRoutes). Capacity in units of goods a trip; speed in tiles a day; a carter is paid the manor's day wage (balance helper_wage), so a route's cost is labour paid to the party that hauls, never coins destroyed. terrain: tiles of each kind cost this many tiles of travel (solid is impassable). Agent proposals, provisional.

market._note: Regional supply and demand (RegionalMarket). reserve_days: how many days of its own need a settlement keeps before it sells, and wants in store before it stops buying; scarcity_premium: how far above value a buyer will pay when it holds none of its horizon need (linearly less as it holds more); cash_floor: coins a settlement keeps back from trade; preferred_margin_pct: a cooperation partner wins a sale when its delivered price is within this margin of the cheapest. Agent proposals, provisional.

experience._note: Owner X18-CAPCOMP part 1 (2026-10-22, docs/directives/2026-10-22_x18_capcomp_experience_decision.md): each person's experience per industry from actual hours worked in this settlement, 1 experience day per 8 game hours (480 minutes), never decaying; caps in experience days; individual level = 10 x min(days, cap) / cap; the industry's workforce level = hours-weighted average of the individual levels of workers active in the last season (2 game days), a reporting and planning metric only. NOT DECIDED (nothing here): starting experience for new worlds or old saves, facility caps, thresholds (WorkExperience starts empty).

facilities._note: Owner Q18-11B (2026-10-22) and X18-CAPCOMP part 1: facility limitations may lower a worker's EFFECTIVE capability, never their experience. Owner D2 (2026-10-23): no limit now, wear later: `caps` is empty, so every effective level equals the experience level; WorkExperience.wear_cap is the seam for the later wear rule.
